programme.title: Robin Lewis Makes
programme.sub-title: Mistakes Can Happen At Any Time On Site
programme.desc: This video documents my first-ever cabinet installation for a paying client — from cutting melamine sheets in the workshop to scribing fillers on site and figuring things out the hard way. I walk through the entire cabinetry process: breaking down materials, sizing parts, installing drawer hardware, fixing mistakes, and dealing with walls that are nowhere near plumb. If you’re interested in cabinet making, furniture building, or starting a small woodworking business, this project shows what the job actually looks like — not just the clean highlight reel. This was the last project of 2025 for me, and a big learning curve — especially around quoting install time, managing client expectations, and understanding where profit actually comes from in cabinetry work. If you’re growing a trade business, thinking about taking on installs, or just curious how cabinet makers price jobs, this one’s for you.

programme.title: Robin Lewis Makes
programme.sub-title: The Most Expensive Plywood I've Ever Worked With
programme.desc: I’m building a custom L-shaped shoe rack using premium Tasmanian Oak veneered plywood with a solid Victorian Ash seat. This project was a great client commission and a fun build, but with timber prices skyrocketing—and Victorian Ash becoming harder to source after the 2023 logging ban—it definitely pushed the limits of my margins. If you’re interested in furniture making, woodworking commissions, or want to see what it’s like working with high-end Tasmanian Oak plywood, this video walks through the full process: design, cutting, joinery, assembly, and installing the solid timber seat. I also talk about pricing custom furniture and how difficult Victorian Ash is becoming to find now that legislation has restricted harvesting.

programme.title: Robin Lewis Makes
programme.sub-title: The Most Beautiful Desk I've Ever Built
programme.desc: Ever thought about making a desk out of end grain? In this video, I take the idea of end grain parquet flooring and flip it on its head — turning it into a custom end grain desk build made entirely from timber offcuts. I walk through the full process of milling, gluing, pattern design, and flattening — essentially creating an end grain board on a massive scale. Along the way, I dive into the big question every woodworker faces: can you glue wood that moves to something that doesn’t? From concerns about wood movement, moisture, and cracking, to experimenting with epoxy and creative inlay work, this project became a long-term experiment in how far you can push the rules of woodworking. Watch the full video to see how I turned a pile of offcuts into a functional, geometric end grain desk — and find out if it actually survived.

programme.title: AI and Humanity: Evolution or Revolution? | Global Conference 2026
programme.desc: Artificial intelligence is no longer an emerging technology: It is a systemic force reshaping economies, governance, and social structures at unprecedented speed. This session will examine the societal, ethical, and economic dimensions of AI’s rapid integration, while tackling critical questions such as: How do we preserve human agency as AI systems influence decision-making at scale? What frameworks are necessary to ensure equitable access, societal resilience, and ethical alignment? How can public and private institutions anticipate the unintended consequences of AI adoption before they crystallize? The discussion will illustrate the interplay between technology and human values, and explore how societies can still shape AI development in ways that reinforce democratic institutions, economic opportunity, and shared prosperity as we define the next chapter of AI and its impact on humanity.

programme.title: How to Launch Businesses with One Prompt | Willo AI
programme.desc: In this groundbreaking episode of The Edge of Show, Zach and Jason Francis showcase the power of Willo AI with a live, unscripted demonstration of building a fully functioning business infrastructure in under 10 minutes. From automated market research and branding to landing pages, GitHub repositories, and live Stripe integrations, the episode highlights how AI is removing traditional barriers to entrepreneurship. The Francis brothers also discuss their 15-year entrepreneurial journey and introduce Helm SEO, their automated marketing platform built for both Google search optimization and AI Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). This episode offers a glimpse into the future of rapid business creation and AI-powered execution.

programme.title: The Blockchain Arcade for Graded Cards
programme.desc: In this episode, Uncle Eddy, founder of Slabs, joins the show to discuss how blockchain and Solana are transforming the collectibles and trading card industry. From his early days filming skate videos and building digital marketing businesses to becoming deeply involved in NFTs, Pokémon cards, and Web3 culture, Eddy shares the journey that led to Slabs — an experience-first collectibles arcade that gamifies card collecting with on-chain ownership, interactive games, and real-world rewards. The conversation explores Pokémon market trends, Solana’s advantages for collectibles, the rise of digital gacha mechanics, and how Slabs is creating a new kind of social and immersive trading card experience.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: How Not to Die
programme.desc: How Not to Die is a bold feature documentary that confronts the greatest threat to human health—our diet. Based on the international bestselling book of the same name, by Dr. Michael Greger, this movie plays like a fast-paced action thriller but is packed with hard-hitting data that just might save your life. How Not to Die exposes the role of the standard Western diet in fueling today’s most widespread illnesses. The film offers jaw-dropping, but evidence-based, insights into the prevention of heart disease, type 2 diabetes, obesity, kidney disease, liver dysfunction, and a spectrum of brain disorders, including dementia and Alzheimer’s disease. It also addresses how diet influences the development of colon, prostate, and other digestive cancers, delivering life-saving information with clarity and authority.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

Forced to accept her circumstance, Nimfa becomes an imposer so Rosette and Jeremy can get away with their affair.

programme.title: Johanna Dohnal - Visionary of Feminism

Women's shelters, gender quotas, and equal treatment laws were established for the first time.

On her trip through this modern purgatory, Petra struggles to make sense of her shooting, together with Gert and other people from her life.

programme.title: I Knew You Were My Kind
programme.desc: The ghostly off-season on the Italian coast. Shortly before their journey home, caregivers Anca and Zoya meet at a bus stop and decide to visit a client's abandoned beach house. A fleeting day of vacation becomes a moment of solidarity and tenderness that challenges the structural norms that govern their daily lives.

programme.title: Impostora
programme.desc: Nimfa, an ugly street vender, meets jeremy, a talented plastice surgeon, in a car accident. To compensate for what happened, jeremy offers to help Nimfa by giving her new face through surgery. In her desire to change her life and escape her situation, she willingly undergoes complete facial reconstruction. She later discovers that her face is copied from Rosette, a wealthy and married woman who happens to be jeremy's lover. Rosette wants to escape her life with her husband and their kids. Forced to accept her circumstance, Nimfa becomes an imposer so Rosette and Jeremy can get away with their affair.

programme.title: Tel Afek (Fort Antipatris), Israel
programme.desc: Antipatris est un site archeologique riche situe sur la cote mediterraneenne israelienne. La ville fortifiee de Tel Afek, a mi-chemin entre Jerusalem et Cesaree, se trouve aujourd’hui dans un parc calme et silencieux. Le site est proche des sources perennes de la riviere Yarkon et fait desormais partie du parc national de Yarkon en Israel. Plus de 6 000 ans de villes successives se sont construites sur la colline surplombant les sources de la riviere Yarkon.

programme.title: Abbaye benedictine d’Abu Gosh, Israel
programme.desc: Situe pres de Jerusalem, dans le village d’Abu Gosh, ce monastere benedictin est l’un des plus beaux vestiges des Croises et l’un des mieux conserves en Israel. Il s’agit d’une eglise gothique construite par les Hospitaliers en 1140. En 1889, le gouvernement français acquiert ce magnifique monastere et le site passe sous la supervision des peres benedictins français.

programme.title: Bella Solitaria
programme.desc: Go Dok Mi es una editora de libros, bastante tímida, se niega a abandonar su apartamento o interactuar con la gente de su alrededor lo mayor posible. Cada día, ella recibe de forma anónima una caja de leche con un Post-it pegado, el que sigue una historia uno tras otro. Todos los días, usando un par de binoculares de color amarillo ella mira a su vecino de enfrente, Han Tae Joon. La última vez que estuvo fuera, fue en un parque en un día de otoño, se había enamorado de Tae Joon, a primera vista, lo continuo mirando y se dio cuenta que adoptó un perro. Cuando miró por la ventana y vio que el vivía en el apartamento de al frente, ella lo asocio al destino.

Elena is a student in Minsk making illegal deals in the Chernobyl death zone to save her father from going to prison. She is in an intense but increasingly destructive love affair with Viktor. When her father is arrested for illegal metal trading and tax evasion, in order to continue his business, she has to keep traveling to the Chernobyl restricted zone.

programme.title: Des Racines et des ailes - Passion Patrimoine
programme.sub-title: Sur les rives de la Garonne
programme.desc: Des Pyrenees espagnoles ou elle prend sa source, au vaste estuaire de la Gironde ou elle se jette, la Garonne parcourt plus de 600 kilometres a travers le Comminges, l'Agenais ou l'Entre-deux-Mers. Le fleuve evolue au cours de ce long voyage. L'apport de ses affluents, comme la Neste, l'Ariege, le Tarn et le Lot, modifie son visage. A bord d'un helicoptere, Didier Taillefer part en Espagne pour faire des photos aeriennes de l'une des principales sources du fleuve : le Trou du Toro. Ce site exceptionnel est situe au pied du massif de la Maladeta, ou la Garonne disparaît sous terre avant de reapparaître au Val d'Artan. Au coeur des Pyrenees, le fleuve donne naissance a un jardin de Cocagne : le Comminges. Dans le village de Huos, Remy Martin a amenage un verger-potager bio sur un ancien meandre.

programme.desc: Maya es una joven magnate de los negocios que ha triunfado en el mundo corporativo. Ella se enamora perdidamente de Arjun, un apuesto galán que ama la fotografía. En la misma empresa trabaja Saanjh, una bella joven enamoradiza.

programme.title: El Gran Vuelo de Córcega
programme.desc: En el corazón del Mediterráneo, Los Exploradores sobrevuelan la montañosa isla de Córcega, con sus 1.000 km de costa turquesa. Presume de una gran variedad de paisajes: el desierto de Agriates, los jardines de Balagne, las Calanques de Piana, lagos de gran altitud y playas inmaculadas.

programme.title: Tiempo Para Saber
programme.desc: Entrevistas y encuentros con especialistas de distintas disciplinas que comparten conocimientos, experiencias y herramientas para comprender mejor la vida, la mente y la energa. Cada episodio propone una mirada inspiradora sobre el desarrollo personal, la espiritualidad y el bienestar.

programme.title: 9 Lives
programme.desc: 9 LIVES portrays the fate of young people who decided at the age of 11, 12 or 13 to leave home and to live on the streets. Any of these young people could have lived nine lives by now and they have been battered, both mentally and physically. But despite this, they have an enormous ability to find their own strengths, gifts and talents.

programme.title: Le Grand Inventaire de la Planète: Nouvelle Calédonie, au Pays des Merveilles de la Terre
programme.desc: The Explorers, menée par Olivier Chiabodo, a déployé ses équipes pour réaliser, en images, l’inventaire des merveilles naturelles d'une terre découverte par l’explorateur anglais James Cook en 1774 : la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Mais également découvrir la culture des premiers habitants de l'île, les Mélanésiens.

programme.title: Armonia Vintage
programme.desc: Gaspar y Majo son dos vaijeros que le gusta conocer lugares sin apuro, y hace muchos años realizaron un viaje por el caribe colombiano, la sierras y montañas de colombia mas Peru y Ecuador, una experiencia unica que nos deja esa sensacion de conocer otros lugares generan bienestar

programme.title: El Gran Vuelo de Francia, Provenza Alpes Costa Azul
programme.desc: The Explorers le cuentan la historia de una región del sureste de Francia, rica en contrastes... La historia de una región imposible de resumir en una sola palabra, por la infinita variedad de sus paisajes y culturas. Es la región Sur, también conocida como Provenza-Alpes-Costa Azul... Una región con tres caras.

programme.title: Le Grand Inventaire de la Planète: Arctique Canadien
programme.desc: Le règne du blanc. Les membres de l'expédition The Explorers partent à la découverte de l'Arctique canadien, une région emblématique du bouleversement climatique qui touche notre planète. Pour être au plus près d'une civilisation et d'une nature en pleine mutation, pour témoigner de l'évolution de la vie sur ces terres glaciales, l'expédition a parcouru le Grand Nord Canadien, du printemps au début de l'hiver.

programme.title: Iditarod, la derniere course Nicolas Vanier
programme.desc: L’iditarod est la course de chiens de traineaux la plus emblematique au monde traversant tout l’Alaska sur 1700km. Nicolas Vanier, grand passionne des territoires du Grand Nord et musher experimente, est celebre pour ses defis polaires sur tous les territoires glaces. L’Iditarod sera son ultime pari.

programme.title: Encuentros Que Generan Bienestar
programme.desc: Encuentros y conversaciones con personas, proyectos y experiencias que promueven el bienestar y una vida mas consciente. A traves de historias vinculadas al deporte, la naturaleza, la salud y el desarrollo personal, cada episodio invita a descubrir nuevas formas de vivir con equilibrio.

programme.title: Der Konzertdealer
programme.desc: In a series of essays, he recounts an amazing biography in which passion for music, business acumen and the structural change of the industry have found a balance. Scumeck Sabottka is a man behind the curtains. He brought a certain band called Red Hot Chili Peppers to Europe at a time when hardly anyone knew the band.

programme.title: El Gran Vuelo Ártico
programme.desc: El Explorador le lleva entre los océanos Atlántico y Pacífico, sobre la inmensidad de los bosques y manglares de Honduras, a menudo envueltos en niebla. La selva alberga las pirámides de piedra de la ciudad perdida de Copán, vestigios del pueblo maya, hoy Patrimonio Mundial de la UNESCO.

programme.title: Un Amor Duradero
programme.desc: La historia sigue a dos personas diferentes, Andeng (Bea Alonzo) y Anton (Ian Veneracion), que demostrarán que dos corazones rotos pueden hacer que su amor dure o no.

programme.title: Alimentacion Saludable
programme.desc: Un recorrido por proyectos, productores y especialistas que promueven una alimentacion saludable y consciente. Cada episodio descubre alimentos naturales, iniciativas agroecologicas y propuestas culinarias que combinan salud, sustentabilidad y bienestar en la vida cotidiana.

programme.title: El Gran Vuelo de Nueva Caledonia
programme.desc: The Explorers sobrevolaron Nueva Caledonia, este excepcional territorio francés, para poner de relieve sus excepcionales riquezas naturales y culturales. Esta expedición aérea nos ofrece otra mirada a bosques profundos y milenarios, montañas de vegetación exuberante, islas paradisíacas, una cultura ancestral, una laguna y arrecifes de coral que albergan ecosistemas intactos poblados por una biodiversidad notable.

programme.title: Marseille
programme.desc: Sophie flees to Marseille. She roams the streets alone, taking photographs. As she abandons herself to the city, she finds it impossible to reconcile her previous life with the now... Slowly, characters emerge and weave themselves into the story - then a cut follows - and Sophie is back in Berlin.

programme.title: Vidas Bienestar Con Estilo
programme.sub-title: Basquet Musica Superacion Sindrome de down
programme.desc: La serie presenta historias inspiradoras de personas que han hecho del bienestar una forma de vida. A traves de deportistas, aventureros y protagonistas del mundo saludable, cada episodio revela experiencias de superacion, conexion con la naturaleza y estilos de vida que promueven equilibrio, salud y armona.

programme.desc: Es un dia especial para Salchi y Martin prepara una torta

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Nueva Caledonia, tierra de maravillas terrestres
programme.desc: Con la tripulación de El Explorador, descubra los confines del hemisferio sur, rumbo al archipiélago Austral. El barco atraca en Rairoa, el puerto y pueblo principal de Raivavae. Una vez desembarcado el helicóptero, el equipo se pone en marcha para ofrecer imágenes aéreas del paraíso.

programme.title: Bella Solitaria
programme.desc: Go Dok Mi es una editora de libros, bastante tímida, se niega a abandonar su apartamento o interactuar con la gente de su alrededor lo mayor posible. Cada día, ella recibe de forma anónima una caja de leche con un Post-it pegado, el que sigue una historia uno tras otro. Todos los días, usando un par de binoculares de color amarillo ella mira a su vecino de enfrente, Han Tae Joon. La última vez que estuvo fuera, fue en un parque en un día de otoño, se había enamorado de Tae Joon, a primera vista, lo continuo mirando y se dio cuenta que adoptó un perro. Cuando miró por la ventana y vio que el vivía en el apartamento de al frente, ella lo asocio al destino.

programme.title: Ashkelon (Parc National), Israel
programme.desc: Ashkelon, une ville sur la cote mediterraneenne d’Israel. Le parc comprend Tel Ashkelon et les vestiges de l’ancienne Ashkelon, entoures par la muraille cananeenne, ainsi que 1 000 dunams de dunes de sable et de kurkar au sud du parc, entre la muraille et le site du pipeline Eilat-Ashkelon.

For Katha's bachelorette party, her childhood friend Charly has come up with a special surprise: a weekend with "the boys".

programme.title: Como Aman los Hombres
programme.desc: Como aman los hombres es una serie de televisión surcoreana. Cuenta la historia de cuatro hombres en sus cuarenta años que han sido amigos desde que tenían dieciocho años, a medida que avanzan a través del amor, la ruptura, el éxito y el fracaso.

programme.desc: Ces enfants vivent aux quatre coins du globe mais partagent la meme soif d’apprendre. programme.title: Garasjen - Spesiell drømmebil, Finnskogfestivalen og en låve full av amcar

programme.title: Garasjen - Nyinnkjøpt Ferrari, Volvo 142 og finale på Finnskogfestivalen

programme.title: Garasjen - Mekking av både Ferrari og Volvo 142, og et lite lakk kurs
programme.desc: Halvor Sunde fra Risør åpner dørene til sin egen garasje, som blant annet huser en strøken Hotrod. Asgeir besøker Arild og hans Ferrari, og gir ham en hjelpende hånd når motoren skal settes inn. Videre går turen til Gatebil on ice i Sigdal.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1980-1990
programme.desc: 80-tallet er preget av racinglegender. En ny verdensmester kommer på banen, og viser frem motorer med 1.200 hester. Porche 959 er den raskeste landeveisbilen i verden. Motorsport har mer å si enn noen gang, og tiårene er fyllt med store motorer.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1947-1960
programme.desc: På slutten av 1940 og 1950 går vi mot en ny start. Etter krigen nærmest stoppet bilutviklingen og produksjonen helt opp, men produsenter fra Frankrike, England og USA begynte sakte bygge biler til sivile igjen.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1960-1970
programme.desc: 1960-tallet er fargerikt og bilmarkedet vokser. Småbiler er blitt veldig populære, og middelklassen er på utkikk etter bil. Hvis du har råd, vil drømmen din gå i oppfyllelse.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der MG4 Electric im E-Auto Supertest
programme.desc: Der MG4 schwimmt auf der Erfolgswelle! Der Überflieger befindet sich unter den Top 5 der meistverkauften Elektroautos in Deutschland. Was der chinesischen Kompaktstromer im Vergleich zum Opel Astra Electric und dem VW ID.3 drauf hat, klärt Alexander Bloch.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Opel Astra Electric im EAS
programme.desc: Kein anderes Auto hat Alexander Bloch bisher in ein solches Wechselbad der Gefühle geschmissen. Von „sensationell!“ bis „macht ihr Witze?“ ist alles dabei. Was die Stärken und Schwächen des Opel Astra Electric sind und ob er sich gegen den VW ID.3 behaupten kann, erfahrt ihr hier!

programme.title: Age Of Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Una società di biotecnologie riporta in vita alcuni dinosauri grazie a una rivoluzionaria tecnologia di rigenerazione della pelle. Quando però le creature preistoriche riescono a scappare da una mostra e a seminare il panico in tutta Los Angeles, un ex pompiere deve riuscire a salvare la figlia adolescente dal caos da loro provocato.

programme.title: Martian Land - Tempesta Su Marte
programme.desc: Nel futuro, la razza umana si è trasferita su Marte e vive in città simili a quelle terrestri, ma protette da enormi campi di forza. Quando una gigantesca tempesta di sabbia sfonda la cupola e distrugge completamente Mars New York, gli abitanti di Mars Los Angeles dovranno cercare di fermare la tempesta, prima di essere i prossimi ad essere spazzati via.

programme.title: 2012: Ice Age - Una Nuova Era Glaciale
programme.desc: Un'eruzione vulcanica in Islanda provoca un progressivo congelamento di tutto il Nord America. Un padre di famiglia lotta per sfuggire all'assalto della glaciazione in arrivo che potrebbe estinguere l'intera umanità. I raggi solari non passano, la Terra sta entrando in una nuova Era Glaciale.

programme.title: Android Cop
programme.desc: Il futuro delle forze dell'ordine. Nel 2045, un poliziotto e il suo partner androide entrano nella Zona, una sezione proibita della città abitata dalla popolazione colpita da una malattia sconosciuta. Insieme scopriranno perché la malattia si è diffusa e, con tutta la tecnologia a loro disposizione, cercheranno di bloccarne il contagio.

programme.title: Kill Mode
programme.desc: Otto anni dopo lo scoppio di un'epidemia, il mondo è controllato da un'industria farmaceutica chiamata The Company. Ma il suo scopo è veramente quello di preservare l'umanità? David Oscar, un ex combattente per la libertà, scoprirà un inquietante segreto che potrebbe far crollare per sempre la compagnia che possiede il mondo.

programme.title: Air Collision
programme.desc: Una tempesta solare spazza via il sistema di controllo del traffico aereo. I passeggeri dell'Air Force One e quelli di un jet di linea si ritrovano in rotta di collisione nei cieli sopra il Midwest.

programme.title: Geo Disaster
programme.desc: Una famiglia di Los Angeles si trova separata durante la convergenza dei più grandi disastri della storia, un super vulcano, un mega-terremoto e un enorme tornado, e cercheranno di riunirsi a tutti i costi.

programme.title: 100 Million Bc - La Guerra Dei Dinosauri
programme.desc: Uno scienziato, insieme a un gruppo di ufficiali della marina americana, torna indietro nel tempo per salvare il fratello Erik e altre persone spedite in piena era preistorica durante un analogo esperimento del 1949 e incapaci di ritornare.

programme.title: Age Of Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Una società di biotecnologie riporta in vita alcuni dinosauri grazie a una rivoluzionaria tecnologia di rigenerazione della pelle. Quando però le creature preistoriche riescono a scappare da una mostra e a seminare il panico in tutta Los Angeles, un ex pompiere deve riuscire a salvare la figlia adolescente dal caos da loro provocato.

programme.title: Martian Land - Tempesta Su Marte
programme.desc: Nel futuro, la razza umana si è trasferita su Marte e vive in città simili a quelle terrestri, ma protette da enormi campi di forza. Quando una gigantesca tempesta di sabbia sfonda la cupola e distrugge completamente Mars New York, gli abitanti di Mars Los Angeles dovranno cercare di fermare la tempesta, prima di essere i prossimi ad essere spazzati via.

programme.title: 2012: Ice Age - Una Nuova Era Glaciale
programme.desc: Un'eruzione vulcanica in Islanda provoca un progressivo congelamento di tutto il Nord America. Un padre di famiglia lotta per sfuggire all'assalto della glaciazione in arrivo che potrebbe estinguere l'intera umanità. I raggi solari non passano, la Terra sta entrando in una nuova Era Glaciale.

programme.title: The Recall - L'invasione
programme.desc: Charlie (RJ Mitte) si unisce ai suoi amici durante un weekend, in una cabina sul lago. Quella notte, un raggio di luce ultraterrena spunta giù dal cielo e rapisce gran parte del gruppo, portandolo sulla nave madre. I due superstiti, Charlie e Annie, devono fare affidamento su un eccentrico e misterioso cacciatore locale (Wesley Snipes), che sembra avere già esperienze dell'attacco.

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: Una squadra di terroristi dirotta un aereo di linea statunitense, lo Starquest, il più avanzato e grande aereo passeggeri del mondo. Quando Harriet Franklin, Presidente degli Stati Uniti, apprende che sull'aereo viaggia anche suo fratello, è chiamata a scegliere tra la sua famiglia e la sicurezza delle persone nelle città sottostanti, qualora il velivolo fosse costretto a schiantarsi al suolo.

programme.title: Age Of Ice
programme.desc: Una serie di terremoti improvvisi e violenti scuote la placca tettonica, provocando tempeste e abbassando di colpo le temperature su tutto il pianeta. Nel tentativo di mettersi in salvo, la famiglia Jones, in vacanza in Egitto, dovrà resistere alle gelide temperature che segnano l'inizio di una nuova era glaciale in grado di ricoprire di neve la Sfinge, le Piramidi e il deserto del Sahara.

programme.title: Global Meltdown
programme.desc: Global Meltdown

programme.title: Asteroid Vs Earth
programme.desc: Per salvare la Terra dall'impatto disastroso con un immenso meteorite, scienza e forza militare si alleano creando un piano ingegnosissimo: far esplodere alcune testate nucleari, provocando terremoti così enormi da spostare l'asse terrestre.

programme.title: RAZOR: Re-wiggling Rivers
programme.desc: Decades of neglect have left rivers and streams across the world in crisis. It’s a complex problem but years of relentless modification has left many unnaturally straight and separated from their floodplains. Rivers naturally should curve and meander, cleaning the water and providing vital habitats for plants and animals. One solution gaining popularity in Britain is “re-wiggling” a river, or restoring it to have meanders and curves. RAZOR’s Gabrielle Lawrence visits Norfolk in England, to see how one “re-wiggled” river has transformed biodiversity in the area and why rivers and waterways need to become valued spaces again.

programme.title: SMILE: Imaging Earth’s Invisible Shield
programme.desc: Following the groundbreaking launch of the SMILE satellite on May 19th, 2026, RAZOR’s Neil Cairns speaks with leading scientists behind the mission at both UCL Mullard Space Science Laboratory and University of Leicester. A rare joint venture between the European Space Agency and the Chinese Academy of Sciences, SMILE aims to study how Earth’s magnetosphere shields the planet from the solar wind. The mission combines Chinese-built spacecraft systems with European scientific payloads, including the pioneering Soft X-ray Imager (SXI), developed in Leicester and described by co-principal investigator Dr Jenny Carter as central to the mission’s ambitious effort to observe this invisible cosmic boundary.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Discovering Guizhou: The Guitar Fanatic
programme.desc: In Zheng'an County, Guizhou province, a thriving guitar manufacturing industry has emerged, supplying major international brands and providing thousands of jobs. In this episode, we meet the guitar-makers, the musicians, and the dreamers who've transformed an entire region by turning strings into stories.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: China's Drone Show Flight Planners
programme.desc: From the skies above Chongqing, thousands of drones light up the night in dazzling displays. Behind the spectacle, a new generation of artists and engineers is redefining entertainment – and showcasing China's growing technological and economic ambitions. In this story, we take a look at the work of a drone show flight planner.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Standing with sea giants
programme.desc: Along China's eastern shoreline, a new generation of energy workers is redefining what it meansto go to work. For offshore wind engineers, the office is the open sea. In this episode of ourspecial series Jobs 2.0, CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu takes us aboard to follow an engineer livingand working above the waves.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who's teaching the robots to work?
programme.desc: As robots gradually move from research labs into real-world tasks, a key question emerges: how do machines learn to handle complex, delicate work? At a Beijing robotics company, engineers are hand-training robotic hands, translating human experience into digital skills that can be replicated at scale. CGTN's Yang Xinmeng explores this emerging profession, speaking with the people who teach machines to cook, care, and manipulate objects with precision. Their work offers a rare glimpse into the intersection of human ingenuity and artificial intelligence – and into the ways humans and robots may collaborate in everyday life.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Highland industries, high-quality future
programme.desc: From smart ranching to vegetable greenhouses, from cold-chain logistics to cross-border trade… We take a look at Xizang's industrial transformation and see how the plateau is leaping into a new era of development.

programme.title: What the FT Story on China’s Poverty Didn’t Show You
programme.desc: A recent Financial Times article questioning China’s claim of eradicating poverty has sparked widespread debate over accuracy, narrative framing, and the use of evidence. Is this a case of healthy skepticism—or selective storytelling? Host Ge Anna speaks with Prof. Robert Walker, who was interviewed for the piece and says key parts of his explanation on China’s poverty alleviation efforts were omitted from the report. In his response article, Media Mythmaking: Mistake, Mischief or Malevolence?, he argues the real issue is not criticism itself, but how selective framing shapes perception.

programme.title: China's private sector law turns one
programme.desc: One year after the implementation of China's Private Sector Promotion Law, attention is shifting from policy rollout to real-world impact. How effective has the law been in strengthening confidence, improving market access and supporting long-term business development? Join us on BizTalk as we examine the first year of the Private Sector Promotion Law: its impact and what it signals for the future of China's private economy.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: Global Business-American Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programme.title: Quanzhou Puppet Theater: China’s "Pinocchio Adventure"
programme.desc: In the film, the puppet Pinocchio, carved and created by an old carpenter, comes to life as a real human. Puppets are lifeless by nature—it is the masterful skills of their puppeteers’ fingertips that breathe life into them. What does China’s own "Pinocchio Adventure" look like? This episode takes you into the world of Quanzhou String Puppet Theater. Explore behind-the-scenes stories, from the intricate carving of puppet heads to the art of puppet performance, and witness how the dance of ten fingers and threads weaves a thousand vivid characters to life!

programme.title: Young star on green field
programme.desc: Meet Sun Chenxi, a 12-year-old soccer "star" from Ningbo who first picked up the game at the age of four and is already playing with the confidence of a veteran. Sun says he dreams of turning pro one day and leading China's men's team to the World Cup. Dribbling and passing with skills far more advanced than his age, he has won over audiences far and wide after his father posted clips of Sun flashing his fancy footwork on social media. The soon-to-be-teenager now has millions of followers online. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: Escape to Yibin
programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as "The First City along the Yangtze River", home to renowned Yibin Ranmian noodles and Wuliangye liquor. We explored plenty of lesser-known scenic spots: Lizhuang, the cultural hub during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; vast bamboo groves that embody the hermit culture of China; and the mysterious cliff-hanging coffins. It is precisely these secluded and strategically advantageous lands that enabled local cultures to be well preserved amid turbulent times.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 1
programme.desc: Nanjing, an ancient city that served as the capital of six imperial dynasties, stands as a testament to China's long-standing history and rich culture. From its Porcelain Tower - one of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages, to its grand city walls and ancient palaces, join us on a voyage across time to experience the echoes of history in Nanjing's storied bricks.

programme.title: New Year with the Miao
programme.desc: In this episode, it’s Miao New Year, and that means multitudes of merrymaking! Fishing, drinking, bullfighting… Join the host Min-Zhui Lee, among the magnificent mountains of Leishan, where it’s all happening for the ethnic Miao.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

Puppets are lifeless by nature—it is the masterful skills of their puppeteers’ fingertips that breathe life into them. What does China’s own "Pinocchio Adventure" look like? This episode takes you into the world of Quanzhou String Puppet Theater. Explore behind-the-scenes stories, from the intricate carving of puppet heads to the art of puppet performance, and witness how the dance of ten fingers and threads weaves a thousand vivid characters to life!

programme.title: Young star on green field
programme.desc: Meet Sun Chenxi, a 12-year-old soccer "star" from Ningbo who first picked up the game at the age of four and is already playing with the confidence of a veteran. Sun says he dreams of turning pro one day and leading China's men's team to the World Cup. Dribbling and passing with skills far more advanced than his age, he has won over audiences far and wide after his father posted clips of Sun flashing his fancy footwork on social media. The soon-to-be-teenager now has millions of followers online. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: Escape to Yibin
programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as "The First City along the Yangtze River", home to renowned Yibin Ranmian noodles and Wuliangye liquor. We explored plenty of lesser-known scenic spots: Lizhuang, the cultural hub during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; vast bamboo groves that embody the hermit culture of China; and the mysterious cliff-hanging coffins. It is precisely these secluded and strategically advantageous lands that enabled local cultures to be well preserved amid turbulent times.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 1
programme.desc: Nanjing, an ancient city that served as the capital of six imperial dynasties, stands as a testament to China's long-standing history and rich culture. From its Porcelain Tower - one of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages, to its grand city walls and ancient palaces, join us on a voyage across time to experience the echoes of history in Nanjing's storied bricks.

programme.title: New Year with the Miao
programme.desc: In this episode, it’s Miao New Year, and that means multitudes of merrymaking! Fishing, drinking, bullfighting… Join the host Min-Zhui Lee, among the magnificent mountains of Leishan, where it’s all happening for the ethnic Miao.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xilingol
programme.desc: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is located in the northern part of China, stretching from northeast to southwest side. In Xilin Gol, the horses, sheep and cows could be found every where. The local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia. Have you ever tried salted milk tea? Just join in this visual trip！

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food: From boozy sticky rice for breakfast, to the famous "Crossing the Bridge" rice noodles, and evening barbecues, there's plenty on offer here. Also, it's mushroom season, and Tianran is taking to the hills to hunt for wild fungi – but he'll need a trusty friend to steer him away from the poisonous ones!

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: Basketball dreams soar in Liangshan
programme.desc: Meet basketball girl Aguolieha, who comes from a rural village in the mountainous Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in southwest China. Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. At first, her father was not supportive as he feared that sports training would make her grades fall. Proving to be excellent both academically and on the court, she often looks up to her idol Stephen Curry, and trains hard with her peers. She believes that the sky's the limit and that basketball games will help her dreams soar.

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. The cultural relics at Sanxingdui are precious cultural heritage of mankind, which contain rich historical, cultural and scientific value, and bespeak themselves as the most attractive ones amongst the multitude of the spectacular relics in China. In this episode, under the guide of the presenter, we visit the Sanxingdui Site Garden, archaeological Site and Sanxingdui Museum, show the amazing giant bronze mask, exquisite gold stuff, marvelous bronze divine tree etc., re-explore this mysterious and great civilization 3000 years ago.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 2
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the grand old mansions of Nanjing’s merchant families and take a stroll through their exquisite gardens, where Nature is incorporated into the architecture. From centuries-old Qing Dynasty residences to traditional folk handicrafts, join us on a deep dive into Nanjing’s rich cultural heritage.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: World Heritages in China: A Journey on Water from Wuxi to Yixing
programme.desc: Water has always been the heartbeat of human civilization, nurturing the cities it weaves through. From the first drops that carved out its waterways to the thriving metropolis we see today, Wuxi’s story is inseparable from the grand canal. This is the story of a city born of water. In this episode, we uncover how the waters have shaped Wuxi’s identity.

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts and Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. Through in-depth conversations with renowned masters such as Zhong Xueyong, Cai Chongguang, Jake Pinnick, and Liu Xiang, this episode explores the philosophy, techniques, and living spirit of Wudang Quan and Taichi. From the internal cultivation of qi to the harmony between body and mind, Wudang martial arts are more than just physical training—they are a way of life rooted in the Tao. Alongside martial techniques, the program also delves into traditional Chinese music, calligraphy, and medicine, revealing how these disciplines come together in the pursuit of balance, self-awareness, and longevity. This is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.desc: Un joven niño costarricense intenta ayudar a su hermano mayor, quien se ha enfrentado a un peligroso traficante de drogas.

programme.desc: Un hombre solitario enfrenta su jubilación cuando una joven afirma ser su hija y transforma su vida.
